from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL-prime-agent-luna6-medium-fresh0/frozen/seen-reference/play/users/u023/system/state/workspace/programs/task-d3675f46.py')
code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    full_lines = [grid[r][0] for r in range(h) if all(v == grid[r][0] for v in grid[r])]
    full_lines += [grid[0][c] for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == grid[0][c] for r in range(h))]
    divider = max(set(full_lines), key=full_lines.count)
    bg = max(set(v for row in grid for v in row if v != divider), key=lambda v: sum(x == v for row in grid for x in row))
    row_divs = [r for r in range(h) if all(v == divider for v in grid[r])]
    col_divs = [c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == divider for r in range(h))]
    r_bounds = [-1] + row_divs + [h]
    c_bounds = [-1] + col_divs + [w]
    out = []
    for ri in range(len(r_bounds)-1):
        row = []
        for ci in range(len(c_bounds)-1):
            cells = [grid[r][c] for r in range(r_bounds[ri]+1, r_bounds[ri+1]) for c in range(c_bounds[ci]+1, c_bounds[ci+1])]
            n = sum(v != bg and v != divider for v in cells)
            row.append(1 if n > 1 else bg)
        out.append(row)
    return out
'''
p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
p.write_text(code)
